description: Dual-layer semantic model: SQL (fact_flight_info only — no dim tables) + SPARQL (GraphDB OWL/RDF ontology). SQL owns flight transaction data (codes and numerics only); GraphDB owns all entity resolution, name lookup, and destination enrichment. Enrichment intents only fire after a primary SQL result exists.

airport.note: Airport entities live only in GraphDB. SQL fact table stores airport codes only — no dim_airport table exists.

city.note: City entities live only in GraphDB. Resolved via SPARQL airport→city chain.

country.note: Country entities live only in GraphDB. Resolved via SPARQL airport→city→country chain.

airline.note: Airline names live only in GraphDB. SQL fact table stores the airline code only.

aircraft.note: Aircraft model names live only in GraphDB. SQL fact table stores the aircraft code only.

route.note: Route entities live only in GraphDB. SQL fact table tracks actual fares per flight combination.

origin.description: IATA airport code for the departure airport. City-to-airport mappings: Tokyo=NRT (Narita) or HND (Haneda), London=LHR (Heathrow), Bangkok=BKK (Suvarnabhumi), Paris=CDG (Charles de Gaulle), New York=JFK or EWR, Singapore=SIN, Hong Kong=HKG, Kuala Lumpur=KUL, Sydney=SYD, Dubai=DXB, Bali=DPS, Jakarta=CGK, Seoul=ICN, Osaka=KIX, Taipei=TPE. When multiple airports serve a city, prefer the main international airport.

destination.description: IATA airport code for the destination airport. City-to-airport mappings: Tokyo=NRT (Narita) or HND (Haneda), London=LHR (Heathrow), Bangkok=BKK (Suvarnabhumi), Paris=CDG (Charles de Gaulle), New York=JFK or EWR, Singapore=SIN, Hong Kong=HKG, Kuala Lumpur=KUL, Sydney=SYD, Dubai=DXB, Bali=DPS, Jakarta=CGK, Seoul=ICN, Osaka=KIX, Taipei=TPE. When multiple airports serve a city, prefer the main international airport.

destination_airport_code.description: IATA airport code for the destination (e.g. BKK, SIN, MAN). Resolve city or country names to their primary airport code — do not ask the user for the code.

airport_code.description: IATA airport code — used for airport-specific queries such as amenities

country.description: Country name matching ex:prop_countryName in GraphDB, e.g. Japan. Resolved to airport codes via SPARQL before SQL is queried.

country_name.description: Country name used for standalone country fact queries, e.g. Australia

destination_country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the destination country — resolved from SQL result airport → city → country via SPARQL

passport_country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the user's passport country — from account context or explicit user input

airline_code.description: IATA airline code as stored in fact_flight_info.f_airline_code, e.g. SQ for Singapore Airlines

aircraft_model.description: Aircraft model name matching ex:prop_aircraftModel in GraphDB, e.g. B777-300ER, A350-900. Resolved to aircraft code via SPARQL before SQL is queried.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code to filter fares by, e.g. SGD, THB

continent.description: Continent name as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_continent on Country nodes

region.description: Sub-continental region as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_region on Country nodes, e.g. Southeast Asia, East Asia, Western Europe

travel_style.description: Travel style tag as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_travelStyleName on TravelStyle nodes

safety_tier.description: Safety tier as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_safetyTier on City nodes

weather_profile_code.description: Weather profile code as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_weatherProfileCode, e.g. tropical_rainforest, tropical_monsoon, subtropical

season_code.description: Season code as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_seasonCode, e.g. dry, wet, monsoon, summer, winter

attraction_type.description: Attraction type as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_attractionType, e.g. beach, museum, nightlife, religious_site, nature

festival_type.description: Festival type as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_festivalType, e.g. food, music, cultural, religious, sports

transport_mode.description: Transport mode name as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_transportModeName, e.g. metro, tram, high_speed_rail, bus, taxi

visa_policy_name.description: Visa policy name as stored in GraphDB ex:prop_visaPolicyName on VisaPolicy nodes

cabin_class.description: Cabin class as stored in fact_flight_info.f_cabin_class

departure_date.description: Exact departure date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. If user says 'June' or 'June 2026', use the 1st of that month (e.g. 2026-06-01).

from_date.description: Earliest acceptable departure date (inclusive) — used by next_available_flight

start_date.description: Start of departure date window in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. If user says 'June' or 'June 2026', use 2026-06-01.

end_date.description: End of departure date window in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. If user says 'June' or 'June 2026', use 2026-06-30.

max_price.description: Maximum acceptable flight fare total in the stored currency. Flight fare only — does not include hotel, activities or ground costs.

max_duration_mins.description: Maximum flight duration in minutes — used to find short-haul destinations (e.g. 120 = under 2 hours)

min_duration_mins.description: Minimum flight duration in minutes — used to find long-haul destinations (e.g. 600 = over 10 hours)

month_num.description: Calendar month number (1=January … 12=December) — used to filter weather observations

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return

username.description: Authenticated user's username — used to resolve passport country from GraphDB Account node without requiring the user to state their passport country explicitly

cheapest_fare.description: Lowest total flight fare amount across matching flights

avg_fare.description: Average flight fare total for a route or grouping

avg_flight_duration.description: Average flight duration in minutes for matching flights

min_flight_duration.description: Shortest flight duration in minutes for matching flights

flight_count.description: Number of distinct flight combinations matching the filter

cheapest_flight_on_route.description: Find the cheapest flight fare (flight fare only) for a direct route between two airports within a departure date window.
examples: What is the cheapest flight from SIN to BKK in June 2026?
Find the lowest fare from SIN to BKK between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30.
Cheapest one-way from KUL to SIN in June 2026?
cheapest_flight_on_route.sql_template: SELECT f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_airline_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS cheapest_fare, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_airline_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY cheapest_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
cheapest_flight_on_route.note: Append AND f.f_trip_type = :trip_type if trip_type provided. Append AND f.f_currency_code = :currency_code if currency_code provided. Airline name and aircraft model resolved from f_airline_code via GraphDB enrichment.

cheapest_flight_by_airline.description: Find the cheapest flight fare offered by a specific airline on a route within a date window.
examples: What is the cheapest Singapore Airlines flight from SIN to NRT in June 2026?
Cheapest SQ fare from SIN to BKK between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30.
Lowest AirAsia price from KUL to SIN in July 2026?
cheapest_flight_by_airline.sql_template: SELECT f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS cheapest_fare, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND f.f_airline_code = :airline_code AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY cheapest_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
cheapest_flight_by_airline.note: Airline name and aircraft model resolved from codes via GraphDB enrichment after SQL returns results.

route_statistics.description: Return summary statistics for a route: average fare, minimum fare, maximum fare, average flight duration, and total flight count within a date window.
examples: What is the average fare from SIN to NRT in June 2026?
What is the average flight duration from SIN to LHR?
Give me fare stats for SIN to BKK in June 2026.
route_statistics.sql_template: SELECT f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code, AVG(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS avg_fare, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, MAX(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS max_fare, AVG(f.f_flight_duration) AS avg_duration_mins, MIN(f.f_flight_duration) AS min_duration_mins, COUNT(f.f_flight_combination) AS flight_count FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code

flights_on_date.description: List all available flights on an exact departure date between two airports.
examples: Show me all flights from SIN to BKK on 2026-05-30.
What flights are available from KUL to SIN on July 10?
Flights from SIN to NRT on 2026-08-01.
flights_on_date.sql_template: SELECT f.f_flight_combination, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, f.f_total_amount_fare_total, f.f_currency_code, f.f_flight_duration FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) = date(:departure_date) ORDER BY f.f_total_amount_fare_total ASC LIMIT :limit
flights_on_date.note: Airline name and aircraft model resolved from codes via GraphDB enrichment.

all_flights_on_date.description: List all flights departing from an origin airport on an exact date, to any destination. Use when no specific destination is given.
examples: What flights are available from SIN on 30 May 2026?
Show all departures from SIN on 2026-06-15.
What can I catch from KUL this Saturday?
all_flights_on_date.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_flight_duration, f.f_total_amount_fare_total, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND date(f.f_departure_date) = date(:departure_date) ORDER BY f.f_total_amount_fare_total ASC LIMIT :limit
all_flights_on_date.note: Airport name, city, and country for each destination resolved from f_destination_airport_code via GraphDB destination_overview enrichment.

next_available_flight.description: Find the earliest available flight on a specific route from a given date onwards.
examples: What is the first available flight from SIN to NRT?
When is the next flight from SIN to BKK after 2026-06-10?
Earliest flight from KUL to SIN from today?
next_available_flight.sql_template: SELECT f.f_flight_combination, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_flight_duration, f.f_total_amount_fare_total, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) >= date(:from_date) ORDER BY f.f_departure_date ASC, f.f_total_amount_fare_total ASC LIMIT :limit
next_available_flight.note: Airline name and aircraft model resolved from codes via GraphDB enrichment.

cheapest_month_for_route.description: Identify which calendar month has the lowest average flight fare for a route within a broader date window.
examples: What month is cheapest to fly from SIN to BKK?
When is the best time to book SIN to NRT for the lowest fare?
Which month has the cheapest fares from KUL to SIN?
cheapest_month_for_route.sql_template: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', f.f_departure_date) AS departure_month, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, AVG(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS avg_fare, COUNT(f.f_flight_combination) AS flight_count, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.f_departure_date), f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit

shortest_flight_on_route.description: Find the fastest flight option between two specific airports within a date window, ordered by flight duration.
examples: What is the fastest flight from SIN to BKK in June 2026?
Which airline has the shortest flight from SIN to NRT?
Quickest flight option from KUL to SIN in July 2026?
shortest_flight_on_route.sql_template: SELECT f.f_flight_combination, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_flight_duration, f.f_total_amount_fare_total, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) ORDER BY f.f_flight_duration ASC, f.f_total_amount_fare_total ASC LIMIT :limit
shortest_flight_on_route.note: Airline name and aircraft model resolved from codes via GraphDB enrichment.

shortest_flight_from_origin.description: Find the shortest flight(s) from an origin airport to any destination within a date window. No destination filter — returns the absolute quickest reachable places.
examples: What is the shortest flight from SIN to any destination in June 2026?
Which destinations from SIN have the shortest flight time?
What is the quickest flight I can take from KUL?
shortest_flight_from_origin.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, MIN(f.f_flight_duration) AS min_duration_mins, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_duration_mins ASC, min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
shortest_flight_from_origin.note: Airport name, city, country resolved from destination code via GraphDB destination_overview enrichment.

all_destinations_from_origin.description: List all distinct destinations reachable from an origin airport within a date window with their cheapest fare. No budget cap — returns everything available.
examples: Where can I fly from SIN in June 2026?
Show all destinations from KUL in July 2026.
Which destinations can I reach from SIN this weekend?
all_destinations_from_origin.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, COUNT(DISTINCT f.f_flight_combination) AS flight_count FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
all_destinations_from_origin.note: Append AND f.f_trip_type = :trip_type if trip_type provided. Append AND f.f_currency_code = :currency_code if currency_code provided. Airport name, city, country resolved via GraphDB destination_overview enrichment per destination code.

destinations_under_budget.description: List all reachable destinations from an origin airport whose cheapest flight fare falls within a maximum budget, within a departure date window. Budget covers flight fare only — hotel, activities and ground costs are not included.
examples: Where can I fly from SIN with a flight fare under SGD 200 in June 2026?
Where can I fly from BKK with a flight fare under THB 5000 in June 2026?
Flights under 150 from BKK in July 2026?
destinations_under_budget.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code HAVING MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) <= :max_price ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
destinations_under_budget.note: Append AND f.f_currency_code = :currency_code in WHERE clause if currency_code provided, so budget and fares are in the same currency. Airport name, city, country resolved via GraphDB enrichment.

destinations_by_country_from_origin.description: List destination airports in a specific country reachable from an origin airport within a departure date window. SPARQL resolves airport codes in the named country; SQL checks real flight availability from origin.
examples: Which airports in Thailand can I fly to from SIN in June 2026?
Show me destinations in Japan from KUL between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-31.
Which Malaysian airports are reachable from SIN in July 2026?
destinations_by_country_from_origin.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName :country . }
destinations_by_country_from_origin.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, MIN(date(f.f_departure_date)) AS first_departure FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code IN :destination_airport_codes AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY first_departure ASC LIMIT :limit
destinations_by_country_from_origin.note: SPARQL runs first to collect :destination_airport_codes for all airports in the named country. SQL uses that list in the IN clause. Airport name, city, country resolved via GraphDB enrichment.

route_fare_options.description: List all available flight fare options (flight fare only) for a specific route and departure date window, ordered by price. Includes airline code, cabin class, aircraft code, and duration.
examples: What are all flight options from SIN to HKG in July 2026?
Show me all fare options from SIN to BKK in June 2026.
Show me one-way flights from SIN to KUL in June 2026.
Are there return trip flights from SIN to BKK in June 2026?
route_fare_options.sql_template: SELECT f.f_flight_combination, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_departure_date, f.f_arrival_date, f.f_cabin_class, f.f_trip_type, f.f_total_amount_fare_total, f.f_currency_code, f.f_flight_duration FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) ORDER BY f.f_total_amount_fare_total ASC LIMIT :limit
route_fare_options.note: Append AND f.f_trip_type = :trip_type if trip_type provided (R=return, O=one-way). Append AND f.f_currency_code = :currency_code if currency_code provided. Airline name and aircraft model resolved from codes via GraphDB enrichment.

airlines_on_route.description: List all airlines operating flights between two airports within a departure date window, with cheapest fare, average duration, and flight count.
examples: Which airlines fly from SIN to BKK in June 2026?
What carriers operate KUL to SIN routes in July 2026?
List airlines and prices for SIN to NRT in August 2026.
airlines_on_route.sql_template: SELECT f.f_airline_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, AVG(f.f_flight_duration) AS avg_duration_mins, COUNT(f.f_flight_combination) AS flight_count, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_airline_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
airlines_on_route.note: Airline name resolved from f_airline_code via GraphDB enrichment after SQL returns results.

aircraft_on_route.description: List which aircraft types are used on a route within a date window, with the airlines that operate them.
examples: What aircraft does Singapore Airlines use on the SIN to NRT route?
Which planes fly the SIN to BKK route in June 2026?
What type of plane is used on KUL to SIN?
aircraft_on_route.sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT f.f_aircraft_code, f.f_airline_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) ORDER BY f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code LIMIT :limit
aircraft_on_route.note: Airline name and aircraft model name resolved from codes via GraphDB enrichment after SQL returns results. Append AND f.f_airline_code = :airline_code if airline_code provided.

routes_by_aircraft.description: Find all routes that use a specific aircraft model, with the airlines operating them. SPARQL resolves aircraft code from the model name; SQL finds all origin/destination pairs using that aircraft code.
examples: Which routes use the Boeing 777-300ER?
What routes does the A350-900 fly?
Which aircraft models are used on long-haul flights from SIN?
routes_by_aircraft.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?aircraftCode WHERE { ?aircraft a ex:Aircraft ; ex:prop_aircraftModel ?model ; ex:prop_aircraftCode ?aircraftCode . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?model), LCASE(:aircraft_model))) }
routes_by_aircraft.sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_airline_code, f.f_aircraft_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_aircraft_code IN :aircraft_codes ORDER BY f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code LIMIT :limit
routes_by_aircraft.note: SPARQL resolves :aircraft_codes from the model name. SQL uses that list in the IN clause. Append AND f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin if origin provided. Append AND f.f_flight_duration >= :min_duration_mins to filter for long-haul only. Airline name and aircraft model resolved via GraphDB enrichment.

flight_count_on_route.description: Return how many distinct flight combinations are available on a route within a date window, and how many airlines serve it.
examples: How many flights are available from SIN to BKK in June 2026?
How often does SIN to NRT fly in August?
How many flight options are there from KUL to SIN in July?
flight_count_on_route.sql_template: SELECT f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, COUNT(DISTINCT f.f_flight_combination) AS total_flights, COUNT(DISTINCT f.f_airline_code) AS airline_count, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare, f.f_currency_code FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_departure_airport_code, f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code

destinations_by_duration.description: Find destinations reachable from an origin with flight duration within specified bounds. Use max_duration_mins for short-haul (e.g. under 2 hours = 120 mins), min_duration_mins for long-haul (e.g. over 10 hours = 600 mins).
examples: Which destinations from SIN have a flight duration under 2 hours?
Which destinations from SIN have a flight duration over 10 hours?
Which long-haul destinations from SIN have flights under SGD 800 in July 2026?
Show me short flights from SIN in June 2026.
destinations_by_duration.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_flight_duration) AS min_duration_mins, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code HAVING MIN(f.f_flight_duration) <= :max_duration_mins ORDER BY min_duration_mins ASC LIMIT :limit
destinations_by_duration.note: SQL compiler must build the HAVING clause dynamically: use 'MIN(f.f_flight_duration) <= :max_duration_mins' when max_duration_mins is provided (short-haul); use 'MIN(f.f_flight_duration) >= :min_duration_mins' when min_duration_mins is provided (long-haul); combine both when both are provided (range). Append 'AND MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) <= :max_price' in HAVING if max_price provided. Airport name, city, country resolved via GraphDB enrichment.

flights_by_travel_style.description: Find destinations from an origin that match a travel style (e.g. beach_escape, foodie, adventure), with real flight fares. GraphDB resolves airports in cities tagged with the style; SQL returns actual fares for those airports.
examples: Where can I fly for a beach holiday from SIN on 15 June 2026?
Find foodie destinations from KUL departing 10 July 2026.
Family-friendly destinations from SIN on 5 June 2026?
Where can I go for a diving trip from SIN on 20 June?
flights_by_travel_style.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode WHERE { ?city a ex:City ; ex:prop_hasTravelStyle ?style . ?style ex:prop_travelStyleName :travel_style . ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_inCity ?city ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode . }
flights_by_travel_style.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code IN :destination_airport_codes AND date(f.f_departure_date) = date(:departure_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit

destinations_by_weather_profile.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code IN :destination_airport_codes AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit

destinations_by_attraction_type.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode WHERE { ?city a ex:City ; ex:prop_hasAttraction ?attraction . ?attraction ex:prop_attractionType :attraction_type . ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_inCity ?city ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode . }

destinations_by_continent.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode ?airportName ?cityName ?countryName ?region WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_airportName ?airportName ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName ; ex:prop_continent :continent ; ex:prop_region ?region . } ORDER BY ?countryName ?cityName
destinations_by_continent.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code IN :destination_airport_codes AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit

destinations_by_region.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode ?airportName ?cityName ?countryName ?continent WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_airportName ?airportName ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName ; ex:prop_continent ?continent ; ex:prop_region :region . } ORDER BY ?countryName ?cityName

destinations_by_region.note: SQL block only runs when origin + date params are provided.

airlines_covering_route.description: Find which airlines have route coverage between two airports according to GraphDB Route entities. Reflects airline schedule coverage, not actual available fares.

airlines_covering_route.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?airlineCode ?airlineName ?routeKey WHERE { ?route a ex:Route ; ex:prop_hasOriginAirport ?orig ; ex:prop_hasDestinationAirport ?dest ; ex:prop_operatedBy ?airline ; ex:prop_routeKey ?routeKey . ?orig ex:prop_airportCode :origin . ?dest ex:prop_airportCode :destination . ?airline ex:prop_airlineCode ?airlineCode ; ex:prop_airlineName ?airlineName . } ORDER BY ?airlineName

all_routes_from_origin.description: List all airline route coverage from a specific origin airport according to GraphDB Route entities. Shows connectivity regardless of actual fare data.

all_routes_from_origin.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode ?airportName ?cityName ?countryName ?airlineCode ?airlineName WHERE { ?route a ex:Route ; ex:prop_hasOriginAirport ?orig ; ex:prop_hasDestinationAirport ?dest ; ex:prop_operatedBy ?airline . ?orig ex:prop_airportCode :origin . ?dest ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_airportName ?airportName ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . ?airline ex:prop_airlineCode ?airlineCode ; ex:prop_airlineName ?airlineName . } ORDER BY ?countryName ?cityName

FILTER(?dest != ?passport) }

visa_check_for_destination.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?passportCountryName ?destinationCountryName ?visaRequired ?visaPolicyName ?visaPolicyDescription ?onlineApplyUrl ?visaDurationDays WHERE { ?req a ex:CountryVisaRequirement ; ex:prop_passportCountry ?passport ; ex:prop_destinationCountry ?dest ; ex:prop_visaRequired ?visaRequired . ?passport ex:prop_countryCode :passport_country_code ; ex:prop_countryName ?passportCountryName . ?dest ex:prop_countryCode :destination_country_code ; ex:prop_countryName ?destinationCountryName . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:prop_usesVisaPolicy ?policy . ?policy ex:prop_visaPolicyName ?visaPolicyName ; ex:prop_visaPolicyDescription ?visaPolicyDescription . } OPTIONAL { ?req ex:prop_onlineApplyUrl ?onlineApplyUrl . } OPTIONAL { ?req ex:prop_visaDurationDays ?visaDurationDays . } }

user_passport_country.description: Resolve the authenticated user's passport country code from their GraphDB Account node using their username. Used by the orchestrator to silently populate passport_country_code for visa-related intents without requiring the user to state their passport country explicitly.
examples: Where can I travel without a visa?
Show me visa-free destinations from SIN.
Which countries need a visa for my passport?
user_passport_country.note: This intent is called internally by the orchestrator when passport_country_code is required but not explicitly provided by the user. The username is taken from the authenticated session JWT, not from the user's question.
user_passport_country.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?countryCode ?countryName WHERE { ?account a ex:Account ; ex:prop_accountUsername :username ; ex:prop_hasPassportCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryCode ?countryCode ; ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . }

destination_vacation_plan.description: Generate a personalised tour-guide-style vacation summary for a destination city. Issues one SPARQL CONSTRUCT query that traverses the full destination subgraph in a single round-trip — airport → city → country → currency, language, transport, travel styles, weather, neighbourhoods, cuisines, attractions, festivals — then a conditional SELECT for visa check when passport_country_code is available. Formats the combined graph result as a structured markdown narrative in the voice of a helpful tour guide.
examples: Tell me everything about Bangkok for my trip.
Give me a vacation guide to Singapore.
I'm planning a trip to Tokyo — what should I know?
Plan my vacation to Bali.
What's Bangkok like for a holiday?
Give me a full destination guide for BKK.

ex:prop_safetyTier ?safetyTier ; ex:prop_soloFemaleSafe ?soloFemaleSafe ; ex:prop_safetyIndex ?safetyIndex ; ex:prop_costOfLivingIndex ?costOfLivingIndex ; ex:prop_utcOffset ?utcOffset ; ex:prop_timezoneName ?timezoneName ; ex:prop_publicTransportWidelyUsedInCountry ?publicTransportWidelyUsed ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country ; ex:prop_usesPrimaryLanguage ?lang ; ex:prop_hasTransportMode ?transport ; ex:prop_hasTravelStyle ?style ; ex:prop_hasWeatherObservation ?obs ; ex:prop_hasSubcityArea ?area ; ex:prop_hasCuisine ?cuisine ; ex:prop_hasAttraction ?attraction ; ex:prop_hasFestival ?festival . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName ; ex:prop_countryCode ?countryCode ; ex:prop_continent ?continent ; ex:prop_region ?region ; ex:prop_capitalCity ?capital ; ex:prop_hasCurrency ?currency . ?capital ex:prop_cityName ?capitalCityName . ?currency ex:prop_currencyCode ?currencyCode ; ex:prop_currencyName ?currencyName ; ex:prop_exchangeRate ?exchangeRate . ?lang ex:prop_languageName ?languageName . ?transport ex:prop_transportModeName ?transportModeName . ?style ex:prop_travelStyleName ?travelStyleName . ?obs ex:prop_monthNum ?monthNum ; ex:prop_monthName ?monthName ; ex:prop_avgTempC ?avgTempC ; ex:prop_avgRainfallMm ?avgRainfallMm ; ex:prop_weatherProfileCode ?weatherProfileCode ; ex:prop_seasonCode ?seasonCode ; ex:prop_bestTimeToVisit ?bestTimeToVisit ; ex:prop_weatherSummary ?weatherSummary . ?area ex:prop_subcityAreaName ?areaName ; ex:prop_areaSummary ?areaSummary . ?cuisine ex:prop_cuisineType ?cuisineType . ?attraction ex:prop_attractionName ?attractionName ; ex:prop_attractionType ?attractionType ; ex:prop_attractionTier ?attractionTier . ?festival ex:prop_festivalName ?festivalName ; ex:prop_festivalMonthNum ?festivalMonthNum ; ex:prop_festivalType ?festivalType . } WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode :destination_airport_code ; ex:prop_airportName ?airportName ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName ; ex:prop_countryCode ?countryCode ; ex:prop_continent ?continent ; ex:prop_region ?region . OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_airportType ?airportType } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_terminalCount ?terminalCount } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_isInternational ?isInternational } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_hasTransitHotel ?hasTransitHotel } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_hasLounge ?hasLounge } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_safetyTier ?safetyTier } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_soloFemaleSafe ?soloFemaleSafe } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_safetyIndex ?safetyIndex } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_costOfLivingIndex ?costOfLivingIndex } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_utcOffset ?utcOffset } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_timezoneName ?timezoneName } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_publicTransportWidelyUsedInCountry ?publicTransportWidelyUsed } OPTIONAL { ?country ex:prop_capitalCity ?capital . ?capital ex:prop_cityName ?capitalCityName } OPTIONAL { ?country ex:prop_hasCurrency ?currency . ?currency ex:prop_currencyCode ?currencyCode ; ex:prop_currencyName ?currencyName . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?area ex:prop_researchStatus "pending" } } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_hasCuisine ?cuisine . ?cuisine ex:prop_cuisineType ?cuisineType } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_hasAttraction ?attraction . ?attraction ex:prop_attractionName ?attractionName ; ex:prop_attractionType ?attractionType ; ex:prop_attractionTier ?attractionTier } OPTIONAL { ?city ex:prop_hasFestival ?festival . ?festival ex:prop_festivalName ?festivalName ; ex:prop_festivalMonthNum ?festivalMonthNum ; ex:prop_festivalType ?festivalType } }
destination_vacation_plan.note: Single CONSTRUCT query traverses the full destination subgraph in one GraphDB round-trip — no enrichment_triggers, no parallel fan-out. Parse result with rdflib: airport → city → country → all relationships. Visa check fires as a separate conditional SELECT (visa_check_for_destination) only when passport_country_code is available — either from explicit param or resolved first via user_passport_country using username. ResponseBuilder walks the graph in narrative order: hook → when to go (bestTimeToVisit months highlighted, month_num personalised if provided) → airport amenities → getting around → neighbourhoods → food → attractions → events → travel styles → visa → currency → timezone → language. This is why we use GraphDB: one traversal captures every relationship without complex relational joins.

destination_highlights.description: Returns a compact highlights summary for a destination: what to see/do (attractions by tier), any festivals in the specified month, and weather context for that month. Use when the user asks what is good, what to do, what is worth doing, or what is happening in a city, especially with a month specified.
destination_highlights.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?resultType ?name ?tier ?festivalType ?monthNum ?avgTempC ?avgRainfallMm ?weatherSummary WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode :destination_airport_code ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . { ?city ex:prop_hasAttraction ?item . ?item ex:prop_attractionName ?name ; ex:prop_attractionTier ?tier . BIND("attraction" AS ?resultType) } UNION { ?city ex:prop_hasFestival ?item . ?item ex:prop_festivalName ?name ; ex:prop_festivalMonthNum ?monthNum ; ex:prop_festivalType ?festivalType . BIND("festival" AS ?resultType) } UNION { ?city ex:prop_hasWeatherObservation ?item . ?item ex:prop_monthNum ?monthNum ; ex:prop_avgTempC ?avgTempC ; ex:prop_avgRainfallMm ?avgRainfallMm ; ex:prop_weatherSummary ?weatherSummary . BIND("weather" AS ?resultType) } }

airports_in_city.description: List all airports that serve a given city. Use when the user asks which airports exist in or near a named city, regardless of flight data.
examples: What airports are in Tokyo?
Which airports serve Osaka?
How many airports does Bangkok have?
What airports are there in London?
Does Kuala Lumpur have more than one airport?
airports_in_city.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?airportCode ?airportName ?cityName ?countryName WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_airportName ?airportName ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . FILTER(LCASE(str(?cityName)) = LCASE(:city_name)) } ORDER BY ?airportCode

routes_from_origin_by_country.description: List all destinations in a specific country reachable from an origin airport, based on GraphDB Route entities. No date required. Use when the user asks what cities or airports in a country they can fly to from an origin, without specifying travel dates.
examples: What cities in Japan can I fly to from SIN?
Which airports in Thailand are reachable from Singapore?
Show me cities in Australia from SIN.
What Japanese cities does Singapore connect to?
Which cities in South Korea can I visit from SIN?
What cities in Japan are there from Singapore?
routes_from_origin_by_country.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode ?airportName ?cityName ?countryName ?airlineCode ?airlineName WHERE { ?route a ex:Route ; ex:prop_hasOriginAirport ?orig ; ex:prop_hasDestinationAirport ?dest ; ex:prop_operatedBy ?airline . ?orig ex:prop_airportCode :origin . ?dest ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_airportName ?airportName ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . ?airline ex:prop_airlineCode ?airlineCode ; ex:prop_airlineName ?airlineName . FILTER(LCASE(str(?countryName)) = LCASE(:country)) } ORDER BY ?cityName

destinations_by_language.description: List all destination cities where a specific language is the primary language spoken. Use when the user asks for destinations where a language is spoken, without specifying a date or origin.
examples: Which destinations speak Japanese?
Show me cities where French is spoken.
What destinations have Mandarin as the primary language?
Where can I travel and speak Spanish?
Which cities in our data speak Arabic?
destinations_by_language.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode ?airportName ?cityName ?countryName WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_airportName ?airportName ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country ; ex:prop_usesPrimaryLanguage ?lang . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . ?lang ex:prop_languageName ?langName . FILTER(LCASE(str(?langName)) = LCASE(:language_name)) } ORDER BY ?countryName ?cityName

destinations_with_festivals_in_month.description: List all destination cities that have festivals in a specific month number. Use when the user asks which places have festivals or events in a given month, without specifying a particular city.
examples: Which cities have festivals in December?
Where can I find festivals in February?
What destinations have events in October?
Show me cities with festivals in March.
Which places celebrate festivals in June?
destinations_with_festivals_in_month.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?cityName ?countryName ?festivalName ?festivalType WHERE { ?city a ex:City ; ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country ; ex:prop_hasFestival ?festival . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . ?festival ex:prop_festivalName ?festivalName ; ex:prop_festivalType ?festivalType ; ex:prop_festivalMonthNum :month_num . } ORDER BY ?countryName ?cityName

cities_in_country.description: List all cities and their airports in a given country. Use when the user asks which cities or airports are in a country, e.g. 'what cities are in Japan' or 'airports in Thailand'.
examples: What cities are in Japan?
Which cities can I visit in Australia?
List all cities in Thailand.
What airports are there in the UK?
Show me cities in Germany.
cities_in_country.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?cityName ?airportCode ?airportName WHERE { ?country a ex:Country ; ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . ?city ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country ; ex:prop_cityName ?cityName . ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_inCity ?city ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode . OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_airportName ?airportName . } FILTER(LCASE(str(?countryName)) = LCASE(:country_name)) } ORDER BY ?cityName ?airportCode

country_info.description: Return general facts about a country: continent, region, capital city, and currency. Use ONLY when the user asks about country-level facts — NOT when they ask which cities or airports are in a country (use cities_in_country for that).
examples: Tell me about Japan.
What continent is Morocco in?
What region is Vietnam in?
What currency does Switzerland use?
What is the capital of Australia?
country_info.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?countryName ?countryCode ?continent ?region ?capitalCityName ?currencyCode WHERE { ?country a ex:Country ; ex:prop_countryName ?countryName ; ex:prop_countryCode ?countryCode . OPTIONAL { ?country ex:prop_continent ?continent . } OPTIONAL { ?country ex:prop_region ?region . } OPTIONAL { ?country ex:prop_capitalCity ?cap . ?cap ex:prop_cityName ?capitalCityName . } OPTIONAL { ?country ex:prop_hasCurrency ?curr . ?curr ex:prop_currencyCode ?currencyCode . } FILTER(LCASE(str(?countryName)) = LCASE(:country_name)) }

destinations_by_cost_tier.description: Find destinations reachable from an origin that match a cost tier (budget, mid-range, expensive). SPARQL filters cities by costOfLivingIndex; SQL checks real flight availability. Use when the user asks for cheap, affordable, or expensive destinations.
examples: Show me budget destinations from SIN.
What cheap cities can I fly to from Singapore?
Which affordable destinations can I reach from SIN?
Show me expensive destinations from SIN.
What are the most affordable cities to visit from Singapore?
destinations_by_cost_tier.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_costOfLivingIndex ?cost . FILTER(?cost <= :max_cost) } ORDER BY ?cost
destinations_by_cost_tier.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code IN :destination_airport_codes AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
destinations_by_cost_tier.note: cost_tier maps to costOfLivingIndex thresholds. budget = index <= 40, mid-range = 40-70, expensive = > 70. LLM must translate cost_tier to max_cost/min_cost param.

destinations_solo_female_friendly.description: List destinations that are considered safe for solo female travellers, with their safety tier and country. Use when the user asks about solo female travel, female-friendly destinations, or safe cities for women.
examples: Which destinations are safe for solo female travellers?
What cities are female-friendly?
Where can a woman travel alone safely?
Solo female travel recommendations
Which cities are good for women travelling alone?
destinations_solo_female_friendly.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?cityName ?countryName ?safetyTier WHERE { ?city a ex:City ; ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_soloFemaleSafe true ; ex:prop_safetyTier ?safetyTier ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . } ORDER BY ?countryName ?cityName

currency_exchange_rate.description: Look up the exchange rate for a specific currency against SGD. Use when the user asks how much a foreign currency is worth or what the exchange rate is for a country's currency.
examples: What is the exchange rate for JPY?
How much is 1 SGD in Thai Baht?
What is the USD to SGD rate?
Currency exchange rate for Euro
How much is the British Pound worth in SGD?
currency_exchange_rate.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?currencyCode ?currencyName ?exchangeRate WHERE { ?currency a ex:Currency ; ex:prop_currencyCode ?currencyCode ; ex:prop_exchangeRate ?exchangeRate . OPTIONAL { ?currency rdfs:label ?currencyName . } FILTER(LCASE(str(?currencyCode)) = LCASE(:currency_code)) }

visa_duration_check.description: Check how many days a Singapore passport holder can stay in a destination country and what the visa policy is. Use when the user asks how long they can stay, about visa duration, or maximum stay limits.
examples: How long can I stay in Japan?
What is the maximum stay in Australia?
How many days can I visit the UK without a visa?
Visa duration for Thailand
How long can Singapore passport holders stay in Europe?
visa_duration_check.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?countryName ?visaRequired ?visaDurationDays ?policyName WHERE { ?req a ex:CountryVisaRequirement ; ex:prop_passportCountry ?pc ; ex:prop_destinationCountry ?dc ; ex:prop_visaRequired ?visaRequired . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:prop_visaDurationDays ?visaDurationDays . } OPTIONAL { ?req ex:prop_usesVisaPolicy ?pol . ?pol ex:prop_visaPolicyName ?policyName . } ?pc ex:prop_countryCode "SG" . ?dc ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . FILTER(LCASE(str(?countryName)) = LCASE(:destination_country_name)) }

airports_with_amenity.description: List airports that have a specific amenity: lounge or transit hotel. Use when the user asks which airports have lounges, transit hotels, or layover accommodation.
examples: Which airports have a lounge?
What airports offer transit hotels?
Airports with transit accommodation
Do any airports have overnight stays?
Which airports have lounges I can use?

param_notes.amenity_type: Use 'lounge' for airport lounges, 'transit_hotel' for overnight transit hotels.

airports_with_amenity.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?airportCode ?airportName ?cityName ?countryName ?hasLounge ?hasTransitHotel WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_airportName ?airportName . } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_hasLounge ?hasLounge . } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_hasTransitHotel ?hasTransitHotel . } ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . } ORDER BY ?countryName ?cityName

safe_destinations_list.description: List destinations filtered by safety tier. Use when the user asks for safe destinations, cities with a specific safety level, or wants to filter by safety rating.
examples: Show me the safest destinations.
Which cities are very safe to visit?
What are the safe destinations I can fly to?
List moderate safety destinations
Which places should I be cautious in?

param_notes.safety_tier: Allowed values: very_safe, safe, moderate, caution. Map user language: 'very safe' → very_safe, 'safe' → safe, 'moderate' → moderate, 'be careful' or 'caution' → caution.

safe_destinations_list.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?cityName ?countryName ?safetyTier WHERE { ?city a ex:City ; ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_safetyTier ?safetyTier ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . FILTER(LCASE(str(?safetyTier)) = LCASE(:safety_tier)) } ORDER BY ?countryName ?cityName

festivals_by_type_global.description: List all festivals of a given type (music, cultural, national, carnival, food, etc.) across all destinations, with the city, country, and month. Use when the user asks about a type of festival globally.
examples: What music festivals are there?
Show me cultural festivals around the world.
Which cities have national day celebrations?
Are there any food festivals?
List all carnival festivals

param_notes.festival_type: Lowercase slug. Common values: music, cultural, national, carnival, food, religious, art, film.

festivals_by_type_global.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?festivalName ?festivalType ?monthNum ?cityName ?countryName WHERE { ?city a ex:City ; ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_hasFestival ?festival . ?festival ex:prop_festivalName ?festivalName ; ex:prop_festivalType ?festivalType ; ex:prop_festivalMonthNum ?monthNum . ?city ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . FILTER(LCASE(str(?festivalType)) = LCASE(:festival_type)) } ORDER BY ?monthNum ?cityName

airport_info.description: Return full details for a specific airport: name, city, country, type, terminal count, international status, lounge, and transit hotel. Use when the user asks about a specific airport by code or name — NOT as an enrichment step.
examples: Tell me about Changi Airport
How many terminals does SIN have?
Is Hong Kong airport an international airport?
Does Narita airport have a lounge?
What type of airport is Heathrow?
What facilities does Bangkok airport have?
airport_info.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT ?airportCode ?airportName ?airportType ?terminalCount ?isInternational ?hasLounge ?hasTransitHotel ?cityName ?countryName WHERE { ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode ; ex:prop_airportName ?airportName ; ex:prop_inCity ?city . ?city ex:prop_cityName ?cityName ; ex:prop_belongsToCountry ?country . ?country ex:prop_countryName ?countryName . OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_airportType ?airportType . } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_terminalCount ?terminalCount . } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_isInternational ?isInternational . } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_hasLounge ?hasLounge . } OPTIONAL { ?airport ex:prop_hasTransitHotel ?hasTransitHotel . } FILTER(UCASE(str(?airportCode)) = UCASE(:airport_code)) }

destinations_by_season.description: Find destinations that are in a good season (summer, winter, spring, autumn, dry, rainy) during a travel window, with real flight fares from origin. GraphDB filters cities by season_code matching the keyword; SQL checks real flights.
examples: Where can I fly for summer from SIN in June 2026?
Best winter destinations from SIN in December 2026?
Where has dry season from SIN in July 2026?
Spring destinations from SIN in April 2026?
Where has rainy season from SIN in August 2026?

param_notes.season_keyword: The raw season concept from the user. Use single keywords: summer, winter, spring, autumn, dry, rainy, monsoon, shoulder. CONTAINS matching is used so 'summer' matches summer_peak, summer_warm, etc.

destinations_by_season.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode WHERE { ?city a ex:City ; ex:prop_hasWeatherObservation ?obs . ?obs ex:prop_seasonCode ?seasonCode . ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_inCity ?city ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(str(?seasonCode)), LCASE(:season_keyword))) }
destinations_by_season.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code IN :destination_airport_codes AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
destinations_by_season.note: SPARQL uses CONTAINS so 'summer' matches summer, summer_peak, summer_warm. 'dry' matches dry_season. SQL departure_date must be a specific date range — do not infer from month name alone.

destinations_good_weather_in_month.description: Find destinations that have the best weather (best_time_to_visit = true) in a specific month, then check real flight fares from origin. Use when the user asks where to go in a specific month based on good weather, or what is a good time of year to visit somewhere.
examples: Where has nice weather in December from SIN?
Best weather destinations from SIN in July 2026?
Which destinations are best to visit in March?
Where should I go in October for good weather from SIN?
What destinations have good weather in April from SIN in April 2026?

param_notes.month_num: Integer 1–12 representing the month. January=1, December=12. Extract from the user's message.

destinations_good_weather_in_month.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?airportCode WHERE { ?city a ex:City ; ex:prop_hasWeatherObservation ?obs . ?obs ex:prop_monthNum :month_num ; ex:prop_bestTimeToVisit true . ?airport a ex:Airport ; ex:prop_inCity ?city ; ex:prop_airportCode ?airportCode . }
destinations_good_weather_in_month.sql_template: SELECT f.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, f.f_currency_code, MIN(f.f_total_amount_fare_total) AS min_fare FROM fact_flight_info f WHERE f.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND f.f_destination_airport_code IN :destination_airport_codes AND date(f.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.f_destination_airport_code, f.f_currency_code ORDER BY min_fare ASC LIMIT :limit
destinations_good_weather_in_month.note: SPARQL filters on prop_bestTimeToVisit true for the given month_num. SQL requires departure date range — if user only says 'in July', use that month in 2026 as start_date/end_date.

cheapest_transit_route.description: Find cheapest two-leg connecting flight between two airports that have no direct service. Self-joins fact_flight_info on transit hub with a minimum 2-hour layover. Used as auto-fallback when cheapest_flight_on_route returns no results, and also directly when user asks for connecting flights.
examples: Cheapest flight from FRA to SYD on 1 June 2026?

cheapest_transit_route.sql_template: SELECT leg1.f_departure_airport_code AS origin, leg1.f_destination_airport_code AS transit_hub, leg2.f_destination_airport_code AS destination, leg1.f_departure_date AS leg1_departs, leg1.f_arrival_date AS leg1_arrives, leg2.f_departure_date AS leg2_departs, leg2.f_arrival_date AS leg2_arrives, leg1.f_airline_code AS leg1_airline, leg2.f_airline_code AS leg2_airline, leg1.f_currency_code AS leg1_currency, leg2.f_currency_code AS leg2_currency, leg1.f_total_amount_fare_total AS leg1_fare, leg2.f_total_amount_fare_total AS leg2_fare, leg1.f_flight_duration AS leg1_duration_mins, leg2.f_flight_duration AS leg2_duration_mins, CAST((julianday(leg2.f_departure_date) - julianday(leg1.f_arrival_date)) * 24 * 60 AS INTEGER) AS layover_mins FROM fact_flight_info leg1 JOIN fact_flight_info leg2 ON leg1.f_destination_airport_code = leg2.f_departure_airport_code AND datetime(leg2.f_departure_date) >= datetime(leg1.f_arrival_date, '+120 minutes') AND datetime(leg2.f_departure_date) <= datetime(leg1.f_arrival_date, '+1440 minutes') WHERE leg1.f_departure_airport_code = :origin AND leg2.f_destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(leg1.f_departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) ORDER BY (leg1.f_total_amount_fare_total + leg2.f_total_amount_fare_total) ASC LIMIT :limit
cheapest_transit_route.note: No trip_type or currency_code optional clauses. Minimum 2-hour layover enforced in SQL. ORDER BY is the combined fare sum as a proxy (currencies may differ per leg).

visa_required_destinations.description: List all destination countries where the passport holder needs ANY form of travel authorization (ETA, eVisa, Visa on Arrival, full Visa). Uses prop_visaRequired true — broader than visa_destinations_by_policy which filters by specific policy name. Use this when the user asks generically 'which countries need a visa' without naming a specific policy type.
examples: Which countries do I need a visa for with a Singapore passport?
Which countries need a visa for Singaporeans?
Which countries require a visa for Malaysian passport?
What countries need visa for India passport?

visa_required_destinations.sparql_template: PREFIX ex: <http://dataontology.example/graph/> SELECT DISTINCT ?destinationCountryName ?destinationCountryCode ?visaPolicyName ?visaPolicyDescription ?onlineApplyUrl ?visaDurationDays WHERE { ?req a ex:CountryVisaRequirement ; ex:prop_passportCountry ?passport ; ex:prop_destinationCountry ?dest ; ex:prop_visaRequired true ; ex:prop_usesVisaPolicy ?policy . ?passport ex:prop_countryCode :passport_country_code . ?dest ex:prop_countryCode ?destinationCountryCode ; ex:prop_countryName ?destinationCountryName . ?policy ex:prop_visaPolicyName ?visaPolicyName ; ex:prop_visaPolicyDescription ?visaPolicyDescription . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:prop_onlineApplyUrl ?onlineApplyUrl . } OPTIONAL { ?req ex:prop_visaDurationDays ?visaDurationDays . } FILTER(?dest != ?passport) } ORDER BY ?destinationCountryName
